sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 8123 of 2023
Applicant :- Suraj Yadav
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Civil Sectt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Shailendra Kumar Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Nirmal Kumar Pandey, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

By means of the instant application, the applicant has prayed that this Court may be pleased to direct the learned Court below not to insist the applicant to file separate sureties and bonds in each and every ten cases and accept only two sureties and one personal bond in lieu of all the ten cases.
The learned counsel appearing for the applicant submits that it has become impossible for the applicant to submit separate sureties and bonds in each of cases, in which, he has been granted bail.

He added that the applicant has been granted bail in ten cases arising out of following Case Crime Numbers :-

1 1)Case Crime No. 346 of 2022, under Sections 379, 411 of I.P.C., Police Station-Badosarai, District-Barabanki.
2)Case Crime No. 395 of 2022, under Sections 379, 411 of I.P.C., Police Station-Badosarai, District-Barabanki.
3) Case Crime No. 15 of 2023, under Sections 379 of I.P.C. added sections 411,
413,414 of I.P.C., Police Station-Ramnagar, District-Barabanki 4)Case Crime No. 732 of 2022, under Sections 379, 411 of I.P.C., Police Station-Ramnagar, District-Barabanki.

10)Case Crime No. 88 of 2023, under Section 3(1) of U.P.Gangster and Anti Social Activities(Prevention)Act, Police Station-Fatehpur, District-Barabanki.
He next added that despite the Trial Court granted the bail in aforesaid matters, the applicant is still in jail.
Being poo person, he is unable to produce the sureties in each cases.

It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that in similar circumstances, namely, in the case of Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh [SLP (Crl.)
No.8914-8915/2018] the Supreme Court vide order dated 29.10.2018 has permitted the petitioners to submit separate personal bonds and two sureties of heavy amount to hold good in all the cases.

No.8914-8915/2018]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Referring the aforesaid judgement and order, he submits that the applicant may also be given the benefit of the ratio of the judgement passed in Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky (supra).

Considering the aforesaid fact, the petition is disposed off with a direction to the applicant to furnish a personal bond of Rs. 1,00,000/- and two sureties of the like amount in one case, which shall be treated to be valid in all other cases wherein the bail orders have been passed.
